item.title: Cabo Verde ranks third in governance index
item.description: The archipelago scores below its 2016 levels despite strong performance in rights and participation.

item.title: Cape Verde's education system needs reform

item.title: Praia mayor seeks special status for capital city
item.description: Fernando Pinto argues the capital needs differentiated treatment due to its national responsibilities.

item.title: Banco BAI Cabo Verde launches mobile bank branch
item.description: The first mobile banking agency in Cape Verde will bring services to different locations.
